faq_heading: 2 bedroom townhomes in Abbotsford: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 2 bedroom townhome in Abbotsford right now?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom townhomes in Abbotsford, 106 sold over the past year at a median of $555,000, with the middle half between $416,250 and $605,000.

faq.q: Are 2 bedroom townhomes in Abbotsford selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 29 days, and homes sold for 97.6% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of Abbotsford sell the most 2 bedroom townhomes?
faq.a: Central, with 32 of the 106 sales at a median of $432,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Abbotsford have 2 bedroom townhomes for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Crown Point (6 sales, median $502,500); Crown Point Villas (6 sales, median $564,250); Alderglen (6 sales, median $380,000); Belmont Ridge (5 sales, median $595,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom townhome in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom townhomes that sold in Abbotsford was $401 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom townhomes in Abbotsford compare
A 2 bedroom townhome in Abbotsford sold for $230,000 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($555,000 against $325,000, 5 sales). The strata fee was $401 a month against $470.
A 2 bedroom townhome in Abbotsford sold for $135,000 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($555,000 against $690,000, 255 sales). The strata fee was $401 a month against $385.
Of the 6 cities with 2 bedroom townhome pages, Abbotsford has the second lowest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $388,750 and South Surrey highest at $780,000.
